milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind='block') to verify the player has cleared the vegetation from the weed patch. This is a removal/destruction task, so we check that the placed blocks are mostly gone. Three rules cover all vegetation types: grass (short grass, ~60+ placed via fill), tall_grass (2-block-high, 5 placed around target), and fern (7 placed for variety). The box spans (-2,0,2) to (9,1,9) spawn-relative — generous enough to capture all placed vegetation including tall_grass upper halves at y=1. Small residual counts (3 grass, 1 tall_grass, 1 fern) provide tolerance for edge blocks while still requiring substantial clearing.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the preferred rule type for 'find X' tasks. The light_gray_concrete_powder block is at spawn-relative (5, -1, 7) at ground level, hidden among tall grass. The player must navigate within 5 blocks and face toward it (within 60°), modeling intentional visual discovery rather than accidental proximity. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to clearly see the pale gray block against the green grass_block ground.
